Card Q&A.a: No. Even if multiple Digimon are deleted simultaneously, you can't draw more than 1 card per turn with this card's inherited effect.
Card Q&A.q: If a single effect deletes 2 of my opponent’s Digimon, do I draw 2 cards with this card's inherited effect?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your other Digimon is deleted, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
